issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and cut drive power (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stumbles, stalls or shuts off while driving, often at low speed or pulling away from a stop, and may not restart. Some owners saw no warning light.
issues.why: The in-tank fuel pump can fail, starving the engine of fuel. Two recalls cover these years.
issues.next: Check your VIN for Genesis fuel pump recalls 23V-630 and 24V-282. The dealer replaces the pump for free. If the engine has stalled on you, get it to the dealer right away rather than driving it.

issues.t: Fuel can leak where the fuel pipe meets the fuel rail (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell around the car or from the engine bay, or wet spots of fuel under the hood.
issues.why: The connection between the fuel pipe and the engine's fuel rail may not be tight, letting fuel escape near hot parts.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-229. The dealer inspects the joint and tightens or replaces the fuel pipe for free. If you smell fuel, don't park in a garage and get it checked soon.

issues.t: High-pressure fuel tube can leak (recall)
issues.sym: A strong gasoline smell from under the hood, possibly with fuel visible on the engine.
issues.why: On some early 2.5-liter turbo GV80s, the fuel tube between the high-pressure fuel pump and the fuel rail may not seal.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-208. The dealer replaces the high-pressure fuel tube for free.

issues.t: Seat belt pretensioner can burst in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom in normal driving. The danger only shows up in a crash.
issues.why: When the front seat belt pretensioners fire in a crash, they can burst open and throw metal pieces into the cabin.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 23V-094 (which replaced 21V-796). The dealer adds a protective cap for free. Make sure any earlier recall fix was updated too.

issues.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The digital gauge cluster goes dark or freezes, so you can't see speed, fuel level or warning lights.
issues.why: A software error can make the instrument panel display fail. Two recalls cover different years.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: you may not see your speed or warning lights, so ease off, keep a safe distance, and pull over where it's safe. Restarting the car once parked may bring the display back; if it doesn't, have it fixed before you drive again. Check your VIN for recalls 25V-105 and 26V-019. The fix is a free software update by the dealer or over the air. For 26V-019, Genesis advises turning off HD Radio until the update is done.

issues.t: Rearview camera can shut off in reverse (recall)
issues.sym: The backup camera picture disappears while you are backing up.
issues.why: A software problem can turn off the rearview camera display while the car is in reverse.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-584 and get the free camera software update. Until then, check mirrors and look over your shoulder when reversing.

issues.t: Scraping noise and stalling from torque converter damage
issues.sym: A scraping or grinding noise from the transmission area and, rarely, the engine stalls at idle or while creeping forward.
issues.why: Rivets inside the torque converter, which connects the engine to the automatic transmission, can be damaged or crack.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Stop driving if the engine stalls in traffic and have a dealer check it. Genesis bulletin 22-01-071G calls for a new torque converter.

issues.t: Check engine light from a transmission solenoid or control module
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on, sometimes with rough or unusual shifting.
issues.why: A faulty shift solenoid, the transmission's electronic control module (E-module) or the park position switch can set trouble codes.
issues.next: Have a dealer read the codes. Genesis bulletins 23-AT-001G and 24-AT-003G guide the repair, which usually means replacing the solenoid or E-module.

issues.t: Misfire and check engine light on the 2.5 turbo
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with misfire codes (P0300 to P0304). The engine may shake, rattle or run rough, and in some reports it stalls.
issues.why: One or more cylinders misfire. Genesis issued bulletin 25-01-051G for the 2.5-liter turbo, partly because the misfires raise emissions.
issues.next: Have the codes read soon; a flashing check engine light means stop driving. Ask the dealer about bulletin 25-01-051G and any software or ignition fix.

issues.t: Oil leak at the turbo oil feed pipe
issues.sym: Oil spots under the engine, a burning oil smell, or oil on the turbo area.
issues.why: The mating surface where the turbo oil feed pipe bolts on could be scratched during manufacturing, so the gasket doesn't seal.
issues.next: Have the dealer check under bulletin 23-01-021G. They polish the sealing surfaces and fit new gaskets. Don't ignore it, because oil near a hot turbo is a fire risk.

issues.t: Oil level warning without a real oil problem
issues.sym: A warning light comes on with code P250F (engine oil level) even though the oil level is correct.
issues.why: The oil level sensor logic on the 3.5-liter turbo can set this code when nothing is wrong.
issues.next: Check the oil level the right way first. If it's correct, have a dealer check under bulletin 24-EM-009G.

issues.t: AWD or limited-slip differential warning codes
issues.sym: An AWD warning or check engine light with drivetrain codes (such as P1882, P1889 or P1896), sometimes with reduced AWD function.
issues.why: The actuator for the electronic limited-slip differential (E-LSD) or the transfer case actuator can fault.
issues.next: Have a dealer diagnose it using bulletin 23-DS-001G. Avoid hard driving on slippery roads until it's fixed.

issues.t: Hum or whine from the rear differential
issues.sym: A humming or whining noise from the back of the car at certain speeds, when speeding up or slowing down.
issues.why: The rear differential lock nut can loosen, letting the gears make noise.
issues.next: Ask a dealer about bulletins 23-DS-004G and 24-DS-001G. They inspect and tighten the lock nut or replace parts if needed.

issues.t: AWD always on from the wrong control module
issues.sym: Shifts feel slightly off, AWD stays engaged all the time, and the 4WD light may not come on.
issues.why: Some 2024 models had the wrong AWD control unit installed at the factory.
issues.next: Have the dealer check under bulletin 24-01-030G and install the correct module.

issues.t: Water leak from clogged sunroof drains
issues.sym: Water drips into the cabin, often near the headliner or pillars, or you hear gurgling from the sunroof in rain.
issues.why: Debris clogs the plugs at the end of the sunroof drain hoses, so water backs up and overflows inside.
issues.next: Have the dealer replace the drain hose plugs under bulletin 24-BD-008G. Dry out wet carpet quickly to prevent mold and electrical problems.

issues.t: Headlight fills with moisture and stops working
issues.sym: Fog or water inside a headlight, followed by the headlight, running light or turn signal failing. Driver-assist warnings may come on too.
issues.why: Moisture gets into the headlight assembly and can short its electronics.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect it under warranty if possible, and push for coverage.

issues.t: Horn stops working
issues.sym: The horn doesn't sound when you press it.
issues.why: The horns are mounted flat, so moisture can collect and ruin them.
issues.next: Get it fixed soon, since a working horn is a safety item. Bulletin 25-BE-017G replaces the horns and mounts them upright.

issues.t: Power tailgate won't close or latch properly
issues.sym: The power liftgate doesn't close all the way, and a warning chime keeps sounding.
issues.why: The tailgate doesn't latch properly when closing because of the power tailgate module's software.
issues.next: Ask the dealer for the power tailgate module software update in bulletin 23-BE-004G.

issues.t: Rattle from the tailgate or rear side panel
issues.sym: A rattle from the back of the SUV while driving, especially on rough roads.
issues.why: The side guide bumpers at the tailgate can let the panels knock against each other.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletin 25-BD-005G, which adds washers to the guide bumpers.

issues.t: Rubbing noise when turning the steering wheel
issues.sym: A rubbing or dragging noise from the steering column as you turn the wheel.
issues.why: The clock spring (the coiled connector behind the steering wheel) can be misaligned.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect it under bulletin 25-BE-015G. They may replace the multifunction switch assembly.

issues.t: Steering shudder and driver-assist shutting off
issues.sym: The steering wheel vibrates or shudders, and lane-keeping or other driver assists stop working.
issues.why: Owners report the issue, which may involve the electric power steering or the driver-assist sensors.
issues.next: Have a dealer check for stored codes and inspect the steering and sensors. Don't rely on the driver assists until it's fixed.

issues.t: Genesis Connected Services stop working
issues.sym: Remote start, app features, navigation updates or emergency services don't work or drop out.
issues.why: Software problems and cellular network dropouts affect the connected car module. Genesis has released several bulletins with resets and checks.
issues.next: Have the dealer do the resets in bulletins 24-01-001G and 25-01-005G. Check that your subscription is active.

issues.t: Battery drains while parked
issues.sym: The 12-volt battery is weak or dead after the car sits, and the car may not start.
issues.why: A communication error can keep the touch control panel from going to sleep, so it drains the battery. Genesis also has bulletins on weak 12-volt batteries.
issues.next: Have the battery tested. Ask the dealer about bulletin 25-01-090G for the control panel fix.

issues.t: Infotainment screen goes black or restarts
issues.sym: The center screen goes blank, restarts while you're driving, or freezes after a map update. Bluetooth may drop out.
issues.why: Software problems in the infotainment unit, including after over-the-air map updates.
issues.next: Make sure all software updates are done. Ask the dealer about bulletin 24-01-081G if the screen goes blank after a map update.

issues.t: Door won't unlock with the handle touch sensor
issues.sym: Touching the outside door handle doesn't lock or unlock the door.
issues.why: Moisture can affect the touch sensors in the door handles.
issues.next: Use the key fob buttons for now. Bulletin 24-01-074G adds tape to seal the sensors.

issues.t: Loose windshield trim seal
issues.sym: The trim and rubber seal along the windshield looks loose or lifts away.
issues.why: The windshield garnish and seal can come loose.
issues.next: Have the dealer replace the garnish and seal under bulletin 25-01-077G or 26-01-003G.

issues.t: Driver attention warning goes off for no reason
issues.sym: The driver attention warning chimes every few minutes even when you're watching the road.
issues.why: Owners report the driver-monitoring camera misreads attention. The cause isn't confirmed.
issues.next: Report it to the dealer and ask about software updates. You can adjust the warning in the settings menu.

issues.t: Keyless entry and fingerprint reader stop responding
issues.sym: The doors won't unlock with the smart key or fingerprint, and in one report the car locked with a child inside.
issues.why: Owners report the keyless system not responding. The cause isn't confirmed.
issues.next: Keep the physical key with you. If the system acts up, have a dealer check the smart key system and the 12-volt battery.

issues.t: Paint peeling
issues.sym: Paint flakes or peels off body panels.
issues.why: Owners report poor paint adhesion.
issues.next: Photograph the damage and ask a dealer about warranty paint coverage.
